LanguageData.SSC_PetCatComfort.label: soothing resonance
LanguageData.SSC_PetCatComfort.description: A final Pet Cat can select another conscious player-faction humanlike pawn anywhere on the same map, walk onto its cell, then comfort it for 2 seconds with a progress bar and a steady stream of hearts while the target pauses. Sleeping targets are woken normally; downed targets with enough consciousness can also receive comfort. A target in a mental state recovers; a target outside a mental state with a mood need instead gains Cat Encouragement: +8 mood and ×1.10 global work speed for 12 in-game hours. Reapplying encouragement refreshes its duration without stacking. Completion starts a cooldown of 1 in-game day. Available while drafted or undrafted.
